settings.title: Platform Settings
settings.subtitle: Global configuration, loan rules, equipment and integrations.
settings.group_form_hint: Configure required and optional information requested from students.
settings.group_blocking_hint: Select statuses that make equipment unreservable.
settings.group_email_triggers_hint: Details of every automated email sent by Cook'It: when it triggers, why, and to whom.
settings.smtp_status_unconfigured: SMTP Server not configured (check environment variables)
settings.email_notifications_enabled_hint: Master switch for transactional notifications (OTP sign-in codes always remain active).
settings.email_otp_when: When: On every sign-in attempt on the platform.
settings.email_otp_why: Why: Secure passwordless authentication (6-character code, 10 min validity).
settings.email_new_res_when: When: As soon as a student confirms their cart.
settings.email_new_res_why: Why: Acknowledgment receipt with item summary and deposit amount.
settings.email_approval_when: When: When a club mandate member approves or rejects a request.
settings.email_approval_why: Why: Confirm booking with pickup instructions or explain rejection reasons.
settings.email_reminder_when: When: Prior to the reservation return due date.
settings.email_reminder_why: Why: Prevent overdue returns and remind to clean equipment.
settings.email_reminder_hours_before_hint: Example: 24 to send the reminder 1 day before the due date.
settings.email_overdue_when: When: If the return date is past and items are not returned.
settings.email_overdue_why: Why: Notify student and warn about potential deposit retention.
settings.email_stock_alert_when: When: When a club consumable drops below its minimum threshold.
settings.email_stock_alert_why: Why: Notify groceries manager before full stockout.
settings.email_staff_notification_address_hint: Email address receiving copies of new booking alerts and low stock alerts.
settings.max_reservation_days_hint: Enforced on the server beyond this duration.
settings.auto_approve_reservations_hint: If enabled, bookings are confirmed immediately without manual review.
settings.require_phone_hint: Make phone number mandatory to complete a booking.
settings.require_comments_hint: Make comment mandatory to complete a booking.
settings.deposit_types_hint: Options shown to students upon booking.
settings.equipment_statuses_hint: Add or remove configurable statuses for the catalogue.
settings.blocking_equipment_statuses_hint: Check statuses that make equipment unavailable for borrowing.
settings.allowed_domains_hint: Only emails from these domains can register an account.
settings.discord_webhook_url_hint: Discord channel URL to receive booking notifications.
